# Codebase map (generated — do not edit)

Auto-derived structural facts about `src/`, regenerated by
[`scripts/gen-codebase-map.mjs`](../scripts/gen-codebase-map.mjs). **Do not hand-edit** —
run `npm run docs:map` to refresh; `npm run build` fails if this file is stale.

This file owns the facts that *drift* (importer counts, dead-code, sizes).
[ARCHITECTURE.md](../ARCHITECTURE.md) owns the *meaning* (which file does what, and why).

**Definitions** — *Importers*: distinct non-test files outside the dir that import it,
statically or by `import()` (0 ⇒ no live wiring). *Size*: S <250 · M <1k · L <3k · XL ≥3k non-test
code lines (comments and blank lines are free; tiers, not raw counts, so trivial edits don't churn this file).
*Oversized*: non-test files over 350 code lines and functions (`file#function`) over 100 of
their own — the source-hygiene caps; each is held at its size in `.code-size-ratchet`.

**Totals:** 69 top-level dirs · 69 live · 0 with no live importer · 1844 non-test source files · 93 oversized · 241 nearing the size cap.
